reader.requirement: The program-name of END PROGRAM must be a program-name declared in a preceding PROGRAM-ID paragraph, and (with GR2: it ends the named program, and SR3) that of the program it ends; a name no preceding PROGRAM-ID declares, or one of a program already ended, is refused.
reader.edition-search: EndMarkerPass.cs grepped for Edition.|Year|CobolVersion: only the EditionContext parameter used to position and emit COBOL2793; no edition comparison. The grammar rules programUnit/nestedProgram/endProgramHeader carry no edition predicate; the pass is called unconditionally from BinderDriver (line 90).
reader.witnesses-cover: part: pb988-end-program-name-mismatch covers a wrong name in a nested chain; a single program's wrong name and a name of a preceding but already-ended program are not witnessed

probes.printed: COBOL2793 the end marker names 'EP7Z', but the program-name declared in the PROGRAM-ID paragraph it ends is 'EP7A' (SR2)
probes.expected: refused: no preceding PROGRAM-ID declares EP7Z

probes.printed: COBOL2793 the end marker names 'EP8B', but ... it ends is 'EP8C' (SR2)
probes.expected: refused: sibling EP8B already ended; EP8C has no header of its own

probes.printed: COBOL2793 the end marker names 'EP10A', but ... it ends is 'EP10D' (SR2)
probes.expected: refused: separately compiled EP10D closed with the name of the already-ended EP10A (GR2: the header ends the named program)
accepted when each header names its program

citations.check: OK  §1985:X.2.5.3 SR2  (2.5.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR2

reader.notes: The 1985 wording ('a program-name declared in a preceding PROGRAM-ID paragraph') is looser than 2023's 'the corresponding', but read with X.2.5.4 GR2 and SR3 it constrains the same pairing, and the compiler's innermost-open pairing refuses every misnamed form probed. Names are compared through CobolNames.Same.

refuter.evidence: Read §1985:X.2.5.3 SR1-SR3, X.2.5.4 GR2, X.3.1.3. Probes at 85: re3 - contained PROGRAM-ID re3b closed by END PROGRAM RE3B and container closed by 'end program re3a' (case differs): accepted, printed 'B'. re7 - END PROGRAM RE7C for program RE7B, where RE7C is declared only by a FOLLOWING PROGRAM-ID: refused 'COBOL2793: the end marker names RE7C, but the program-name declared in the PROGRAM-ID paragraph it ends is RE7B'. re8 - a second END PROGRAM RE8B (a name literally declared in a preceding PROGRAM-ID, but of a program already ended) in place of END PROGRAM RE8A: refused COBOL2793 (as SR3 ordering; under GR2 the header must end the named, still-open program, so the refusal is what 1985 requires). re4 - END PROGRAM "RE4A" (a literal; 2002+ style) refused COBOL5506. cite.py: 'OK  §1985:X.2.5.3 SR2  (2.5.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR2'; 'OK  §1985:X.2.5.3 SR1 ... the text is in SR1'.
